devdoc.details: Calculates the voting power for Volta Club's governance system. The calculation takes into account the user’s holdings of Volta, as well as their collateral and debts, to determine their effective voting power.

balanceOf(address).details: External function to calculate the effective balance of an account. It sums the balances of Volta and uVOLTA tokens and subtracts the balance of variableDebtVOLTA tokens. If the debt is greater than the sum of Volta and uVOLTA, the function returns 0.

returns._0: The calculated effective voting power of the account.

constructor.details: Constructor function to initialize the smart contract with addresses of specific tokens.

params._uVolta: Address of the uVolta token contract.
params._variableDebtVolta: Address of the variableDebtVOLTA token contract.
params._volta: Address of the Volta token contract.
